raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 13 (business date 2026-01-17) was delivered twice, at 02:00 and again at 05:00. All 327 txn_ids in it appear twice in raw_transactions, and the copies are identical except for ingest_ts. The silver step does not deduplicate, so 305 POSTED txn_ids are doubled in silver and every gold aggregate for that day is inflated.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.9, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1) d WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
